body.p: Each worker thread of Widget Server 4.2 serves about r = 250 requests per second, so a server with w = 8 workers handles at most T = w \cdot r = 8 \cdot 250 = 2000 requests per second, or 172800000 requests a day.
At start-up the 12 cache shards are warmed one after another, and shard k takes k seconds, so the warm-up takes \sum_{k=1}^{12} k = {12(12+1)\over 2} = 78\ {\rm s} before the server accepts requests.

Plan the offered load \lambda so that the utilisation \rho stays at or below 0.8. With \lambda = 1600 requests per second and T from , \rho = {\lambda \over T} = {1600 \over 2000} = 0.80 \le 0.8 If \rho in rises above the limit, add workers: by each one adds 250 requests per second.
